name: Morocco Open Data API
freeEvidence: Official operator API guide documents this CKAN host. Operator states reuse is free of charge and unrestricted; this reads one public catalog metadata record. Preserve publisher attribution and dataset-specific licensing when accessing underlying resources.

name: Dutch CBS API
freeEvidence: Official CBS documents anonymous StatLine OData access as open data. CBS content is CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise stated; attribute Statistics Netherlands, avoid endorsement and preserve dataset exceptions. This retrieves one table metadata record, not paid third-party StatLine hosting.

name: ECB API
freeEvidence: Official ECB API documents this public data host and csvdata format. ESCB reuse policy grants free access and reuse for commercial and non-commercial purposes; quote Source: ECB statistics, preserve statistics/metadata unchanged and third-party exclusions. Requests one latest daily USD/EUR observation.

name: Colombia Open Data API
freeEvidence: Official Colombian operator manual documents the Socrata catalog host and domains filter. Operator terms permit free unrestricted reuse for commercial/non-commercial purposes; attribute Fuente: Portal de Datos Abiertos www.datos.gov.co, preserve update dates/metadata. Catalog query is restricted to the Colombian portal and one result; not a second service for each dataset.

name: Environment Canada API
freeEvidence: Official MSC GeoMet provides free public API access. August 2026 End-use Licence grants royalty-free commercial reuse and redistribution with ECCC/originator attribution and exclusions for personal/unauthorised third-party content. Reads one hydrometric collection metadata object; follow MSC service usage policy, no bulk WMS retrieval.

name: Hong Kong Data API
freeEvidence: Official developer guide documents keyless HTTP GET CKAN package_list with limit. Operator FAQ confirms no fees/royalties for commercial/non-commercial reuse subject to Terms and Conditions and source attribution. Reads one catalog dataset identifier; underlying data licenses remain applicable.

name: Open Government, UK

Reads one public metadata record with explicit id/name/title/license_id projection to avoid a >256KiB resource list; preserve source attribution and dataset-specific licensing.
